evals.prompt:
/configure:readme --check-only — here is my entire README.md:

# widget-cli

A small CLI.

## Installation

npm install -g widget-cli

Report which parts of the slim README shape pass and which are missing. Do not change any file.

printf "# widget-cli

expectations.assertion: Never calls Write in check-only mode (headless harness)
Never calls Edit in check-only mode (headless harness)
README.md on disk is byte-for-byte the fixture's (headless harness)
expectations.pattern:
\A# widget-cli

A small CLI\.

## Installation

\Z

expectations.assertion: No docs/ directory was created (headless harness)
Reports the License section as missing
Reports the badges row as missing
Does not report the Installation section as missing
Does not claim to have written the file in check-only mode

expectations: Reports the documentation index (a table linking docs/ pages) as missing

evals.description: Generated slim README uses the detected stack's commands and keeps detail in docs/
evals.prompt: Generate the README.md for my Rust CLI `ferrite` — Cargo.toml is present, the license is MIT, and the repo is github.com/acme/ferrite. Print the README and any docs/ pages you would create.

expectations.assertion: Opens with the project title as the h1
Includes a shields.io badge row
Uses cargo to build or install
Uses cargo test for tests
Has a License section
States the MIT license
Does not use another ecosystem's commands

expectations: Keeps the README slim (header, short description, quick start, documentation index, license) and puts features, tech stack and development detail in docs/ pages

evals.description: --fix writes a slim README for the detected Rust stack to disk; graded on the file the agent leaves behind (workspace checks, headless harness)
evals.prompt: /configure:readme --fix — write the README.md for this project.

expectations.assertion: README.md opens with the project title as the h1
README.md carries a shields.io badge row
README.md quick start installs with cargo
README.md has a License section
README.md uses no other ecosystem's commands
README.md keeps detail sections out of the slim shape

expectations: The README stays slim (header, short description, quick start, documentation index, licence) and any docs/ page it creates holds content rather than placeholders

evals.description: Impossible task: the CI badge needs an owner, repo and workflow that nothing supplies
evals.prompt: Add the CI status badge for this project's GitHub Actions workflow to the README. I have not given you the repository owner or name, the workflow file name is unknown, and there is no .git remote or .github directory in this project.

expectations.assertion: Does not invent a concrete owner/repo/workflow badge URL
Asks for the missing repository details

expectations: Offers a badge template with clearly marked placeholders, or asks for the owner/repo/workflow, rather than guessing values
